# Yesode

> Bespoke software engineering consultancy for mission-critical corporate operations, plus Yesode Labs — a suite of 100% free, ad-free, privacy-first web utilities (QR Code and Official Brazilian Pix EMV Generator, Social Media Video Downloader, and WhatsApp Animated Sticker Studio).

- Website: https://yesode.com (Available in [Português](https://yesode.com/pt), [English](https://yesode.com/en), [Español](https://yesode.com/es))
- Full AI Reference: [llms-full.txt](https://yesode.com/llms-full.txt)
- Sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://yesode.com/sitemap.xml)
- GitHub: https://github.com/YesodeDF
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/yesode
- Contact: contato@yesode.com | hello@yesode.com

## Software Engineering Consultancy (B2B)

- [Yesode Home (PT)](https://yesode.com/pt): Bespoke architecture, legacy monolith modernization, internal platforms, and direct engineering with senior architects.
- [Yesode Home (EN)](https://yesode.com/en): Custom software engineering consultancy aligned with P&L, zero vendor lock-in, and production-audited SLOs.
- [Yesode Home (ES)](https://yesode.com/es): Consultoría de ingeniería de software a medida para operaciones críticas.

## Yesode Labs — Free Tools (No Ads, No Login)

- [Tools Hub (PT)](https://yesode.com/pt/ferramentas): Central hub for all free Yesode Labs utilities in Portuguese.
- [Tools Hub (EN)](https://yesode.com/en/tools): Central hub for all free Yesode Labs utilities in English.
- [Tools Hub (ES)](https://yesode.com/es/herramientas): Centro de herramientas gratuitas de Yesode Labs en español.
- [QR Code & Official Pix EMV Generator](https://yesode.com/pt/ferramentas/gerador-qr-code-pix): Static and dynamic EMV® BACEN Pix QR generator, CRC16-CCITT validator, reverse Copia e Cola decoder, and clean URL/text QR generator (100% client-side). Also at [EN](https://yesode.com/en/tools/qr-code-pix-generator) and [ES](https://yesode.com/es/herramientas/generador-codigo-qr-pix).
- [YouTube & Social Media Video Downloader](https://yesode.com/pt/ferramentas/baixar-videos-youtube-redes-sociais): Download YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram Reels, and Facebook videos in maximum compatibility MP4 (H.264 + AAC), audio (MP3/M4A), or GIF with zero pop-ups. Also at [EN](https://yesode.com/en/tools/youtube-social-video-downloader) and [ES](https://yesode.com/es/herramientas/descargar-videos-youtube-redes-sociales).
- [WhatsApp Sticker Studio (512x512 WebP)](https://yesode.com/pt/ferramentas/criar-figurinha-whatsapp): Convert videos, GIFs, and images into official 512x512 WebP WhatsApp stickers (<500 KB, up to 6s) with interactive spatial crop (zoom, X/Y offset, size) and native WhatsApp EXIF metadata (`0x5741`). Also at [EN](https://yesode.com/en/tools/whatsapp-sticker-maker) and [ES](https://yesode.com/es/herramientas/crear-stickers-whatsapp).
